message: I know this may not be an exact fit with what you do, in a number of ways, but even traditional direct instruction models work with what you describe, or can work with what you describe. One can tell (I guess that could mean lecture) about what is to be done, accomplished, attempted, examined or whatever verb makes the most sense. That can then be demonstrated by the teacher to show how it can be done. Students can then get guided practice with the writing, and they can then do independent practice. What you describe above is more sophisticated than that, but I see a lot of parallels. The main one, writing with students and having students write in class, and beyond.
